notes.title: Background Audio
notes.notes:
Greetings, Heroes!

Many of you have asked me - how to make the game sound continue to play when the game is minimized? This is especially relevant for streamers or users with multiple monitors.

There is a solution - you need to open Windows Explorer at [b]%USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\MansLife\Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor[/b] and add the following block of text to the Engine.ini file:

[Audio]
UnfocusedVolumeMultiplier=1.0

Congratulations! Now the game sound will continue to play when the application is minimized.

notes.notes:
Greetings, Heroes!

Today marks exactly six months since the release of Hero's Story from Steam Early Access. I would like to express my gratitude to the entire community of my games and inform you that in honor of the upcoming holidays, both of my games are on sale for a limited time. But that's not all.

[h3]CLASS CHANGE IN TRAINING[/h3]

Did you know that you can change your character's class in training? To do this, start a new game for the desired class, save the game, go to the menu, delete the save, and then start the training. 
Note: do not delete the save if you have not made a backup or disabled cloud saves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/f8ac2078c3011aa97b2e30fb4738bdf36ba23adb.jpg[/img]

[h3]SAVE BACKUP[/h3]

Did you know that you can make a backup of your save in Hero's Story? This will protect you from losing data and will help you restore your progress if you made the wrong decision. Game saves are located in the AppData\Local\MansLife\Saved\SaveGames folder. You can also disable cloud saves in Steam if you need to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/a503891428c47697b35be1a524433b2fc4bb1857.png[/img]

notes.title: Second Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Heroes!

Today a new update for Hero's Story was released.
It fixed the shortcomings of the previous version, added new artifact mechanics and a new location, and updated the game bosses. In this update I tried to listen to the opinions of the players, so the rewards for defeating monsters were increased and the cooldown of the hero's abilities was reduced. I also fixed the annoying hint for players that character can open the door. 
I hope you will like this update!

You can find full list of changes below.


[h3]General[/h3]

[list]
[*] Now ability description will include the cooldowns
[/list]
[h3]Additions[/h3]

[list]
[*] New mechanics: Artefacts
[*] New location: Smuggler's Path
[*] Added new attacks for bosses
[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]

[list]
[*] Slightly increased the distance from which the character can open doors
[*] Decreased the distance from which players can pick up items and see interaction prompts
[*] Warrior: Increased the cooldown of the 'Frenzy' ability from 15 to 20 seconds
[*] Warrior: Decreased the cooldown of the 'Heavenly Armor' ability from 25 to 15 seconds
[*] Warrior: Increased the energy cost of the 'Frenzy' ability from 30 to 35 points
[*] Warrior: Increased the energy cost of the 'Heavenly Armor' ability from 50 to 65 points
[*] Rogue: Decreased the cooldown of the 'Haste' ability from 20 to 10 seconds
[*] Rogue: Increased the energy cost of the 'Fury' ability from 30 to 40 points
[*] Rogue: Increased the energy cost of the 'Haste' ability from 50 to 60 points
[*] Rogue primary weapon damage increased
[*] Mage: 'Fireball' cooldown decreased from 20 to 10 seconds
[*] Mage: 'Lesser Heal' cooldown decreased from 10 to 5 seconds
[*] Mage: 'Fireball' energy cost increased from 50 to 75 points
[*] Mage: 'Lesser Heal' energy cost increased from 20 to 25 points
[*] Mage primary weapon damage decreased
[*] Cleric: 'Flash of Light' cooldown decreased from 20 to 15 seconds
[*] Cleric: 'Greater Heal' cooldown decreased from 15 to 10 seconds
[*] Cleric: 'Flash of Light' energy cost increased from 30 to 50 points
[*] Cleric primary weapon damage decreased
[*] Improved loot from all locked chests
[*] Significantly increased the amount of time the Zombie will pursue the main character
[*] Increased the range and angle of view of the Rakshasa Warrior
[*] Increased the amount of glory points received for killing the Griffin
[*] Increased the amount of glory points received for killing the Shaman
[*] Increased the amount of glory points received for killing the Dark Knight
[*] Increased the amount of glory points received for killing the Scarecrow
[*] Increased the amount of glory points received for killing the Swamp Troll
[*] Slightly increased the chance to block a hit for the Skeleton Warrior
[*] Quivers will no longer drop from Iron Chests
[*] Artifacts can now also drop from Iron Chests
[/list]
[h3]Optimization[/h3]

[list]
[*] Removed unused fragments of program code
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug when players would get too many gold coins from the Golden Chest
[*] Fixed a bug when the "Wanderers' Request" quest would not count
[*] Fixed a bug when the Glory Rank in the character window would not display correctly
[*] Fixed a bug when the player's character would not be forcibly moved to the Endless Desert in one of the cases
[*] Fixed a bug when the Bandits would not turn to face the player during an attack
[*] Fixed some localization errors
[*] Minor level fixes
[/list]

Now let's take a closer look at some points.

[h2]ARTIFACTS[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/d872f682432c288ed730bc290ae73c2b2cab91d8.gif[/img]

Artifacts are the ultimate goal of wanderers' searches. These are powerful items that temporarily grant a certain power - for example, the ability to not spend an arrow when shooting, get additional glory points or reduce the cooldown of abilities. Artifacts can only be found in closed iron chests!

[h2]BOSSES UPDATE[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/1dd20cace0576e25b17dbadabd087a5630bea9d0.gif[/img]

Boss battles in the new version will become more interesting and difficult! Each boss will have a new type of attack - for example, Spider Queen will learn to attack from a distance, High Necromancer will be protected by a dark shield and the Fallen Knight will be able to carry out a deadly ultimate attack. Good luck in battle!

[h2]SMUGGLER'S PATH[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/079138ca2921e95fcf597fc46913259f6422be23.png[/img]

Somewhere in the mountains in the north there is an abandoned passage, which, according to rumors, can be opened with a special seal. They say that this passage has long been used by smugglers and slave traders, and that this path leads to the Trade Coast. Who knows - perhaps you will yet have to go to unknown lands in search of new adventures...

As always, you can leave your impressions of the update in the comments or discussions.

Enjoy the game! Your Silent.

notes.title: First Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Heroes!

Today, Hero's Story received its first major update since its release.
This update added a new dungeon to the game - the Ruins of Shasaf, added a mechanic for fast travel through the Obelisks, and fixed a large number of various bugs.
Please note that Shasaf will only open after completing the game, and to move through the obelisks, you will first need to find a valuable item.
I hope you enjoy this update!

You can find full list of changes below.


[h3]General[/h3]

[list]
[*] Now when trying to move to the Swamp of Myths, a corresponding warning will be displayed
[*] Changed the description of the 'Learning Stones' achievement
[*] Changed (corrected) the description of the Fire Protection Potion
[/list]
[h3]Additions[/h3]

[list]
[*] New location: Ruins of Shasaf
[*] New mechanics: Fast Travel
[*] Added new items to some merchants
[*] Added additional save points in the Swamp of Myths
[*] Added sound when putting on an amulet
[*] Updated the icon of the executable file
[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]

[list]
[*] Slightly increased the chance of Antidote dropping from shamans
[*] Slightly increased the chance of Quiver dropping from skeleton archers
[*] Adjusted the height of the poisonous area in the Swamp of Myths
[*] Reduced the amount of glory points given for completing some actions
[/list]
[h3]Optimization[/h3]

[list]
[*] Limited the area of ​​​​lighting calculation on some levels
[*] Removed temporary files from the project folder
[*] Removed unused fragments of program code
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug when quests in the list on the left were incorrectly marked as completed
[*] Fixed a bug when chests would sometimes be empty after loading the game
[*] Fixed a bug when the hover tooltip for some glory ranks was displayed incorrectly
[*] Fixed a bug when the hover tooltip for some merchant goods was displayed incorrectly
[*] Fixed a bug when some NPCs and quest items would remain in place after completing the corresponding quests
[*] Fixed a bug when the main quest would not update correctly in some cases
[*] Fixed a bug preventing one of the Steam achievements from being obtained
[*] Fixed a bug with the critical hit chance display in the character screen
[*] Minor level fixes
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]

[list]
[*] Changed the game build settings so that game updates take up less space and load faster
[/list]

Now let's take a closer look at some points.

[h2]RUINS OF SHASAF[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/c0862dbd7519dd9f621e8a34649b0045878ea3f3.png[/img]

The ruins of the once proud wanderer city of Shasaf are located in the east of the Endless Desert.
Magical storms and fortress walls reliably protect the peace of the city's inhabitants from careless travelers and desert spirits.
They say that the passage to them will open only when a great evil is defeated.
They also say that the city has long been empty and has become a haven for spirits...

[h2]MYSTERY OF THE OBELISK[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/e29758d10787d1dc2c5845a686a36b0a93464db6.png[/img]

The obelisks scattered throughout Teandria have long attracted the attention of various researchers!
Such mages as Algus and Angelica have long tried to compare ancient records, and came to the conclusion that the monuments can be used as a kind of portals.
However, to activate them, you will need a fragment of an ancient crystal hidden deep in the ancient Angalar catacombs...
Players will be able to quickly move between already found obelisks after activating the crystal.

[h2]BUGFIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

After the release of any game, there are still things that require attention.
Although most of the critical bugs were fixed immediately after the release with the help of small updates, nevertheless, there are still bugs in the game.
In this update, problems with game levels, the ability to increase the chance of a critical hit and some other errors were fixed.
In future updates, I will continue to fix and improve the game - but after my trip for treatment.

As always, you can leave your impressions of the update in the comments or discussions.

Enjoy the game! Your Silent.

notes.title: Hero's Story Release
notes.notes:
Greetings, Heroes! Finally, this day has come.

Today the full version of Hero's Story has become available to players.
In the release version, players have access to the tutorial, a new region - the Swamp of Myths, and the opportunity to defeat the final boss and complete the game!
Also, new achievements, enemies, items were added, and a large number of various bugs were fixed.
Controller support was improved and localization was supplemented. Class balance and loot from monsters were also adjusted.
Note that this is not the last version of the game, and after the launch, various fixes and updates will be released for Hero's Story.
Thanks to everyone who supported the development of the game during Early Access!

You can find the full list of changes below as usual.

[*] All transitions between locations (except portals) now have the same appearance

[*] Changed the description of the Anti-Magic Potion
[*] Updated the game build configuration
[/list]

Let's take a closer look at some points.

[h2]DESTROYER OF WORLDS[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/7cc296f75cbc93c8a765965616470943b9a24980.jpg[/img]

A man named Algus began his journey as a wizard in the academies of Angalar, where he studied the art of magic. Over time, his heart began to gravitate towards forbidden and dark knowledge.
With charisma and the ability to convince people of his rightness, Algus began to gather acolytes around him, ready to follow him into the darkness. One day, Algus stole an ancient artifact with colossal magical power and disappeared without a trace for many years. It was believed that he died.
Now, Algus's tracks have led wanderers to a mysterious swamp in the north, where the sinister wizard seems to have opened his new abode...
In a place where nature and magic intertwine, he again began to sow discord and fear, returning to take over the kingdom - or destroy it!

[h2]TUTORIAL[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/b00ec3d51e5279dfa210f46380f36d36138605bd.jpg[/img]

Join the ranks of the Royal Guard and become a skilled warrior to fight the enemies of the kingdom, explore the world and search for artifacts!
You will undergo training in the Arsenal, where you will learn movement, exploration and the basics of combat. Our best instructors will lead you through a series of simple tests, after which you will be able to confidently enter the lands of Teandria.
Hero's Story players have long been asking for a tutorial system, and in the full version this request has finally been fulfilled. All new players in Hero's Story will be offered to complete the tutorial (or if you delete your save). Good luck in the game!

[h2]SWAMP OF MYTHS[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/eae8aea202722f0a7cbafe64fb019e521db8c128.jpg[/img]

In the north of the kingdom of Teandria there is a poisonous magical swamp, in which ancient evil lurks. This ominous place is covered in misty darkness and filled with twisted magic, permeated with toxic fumes! The wild inhabitants of this inhospitable place handle powerful spells, which fills the hearts of even the bravest adventurers with anxiety.
Among the ominous branches and spreading bushes rises the formidable temple of Hamuraptra - an ancient sanctuary, where ancient spells still sound like an eternal echo.
Whoever dares to cross the swamp and enter the ancient temple will open the doors to old magic and secrets, but will also sacrifice his soul on the altar of everlasting evil...

Enjoy the game! Your Silent.

notes.title: Great Dragon Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Heroes.

Today a major update was released for Hero's Story.
This update added a new region - Isil Plateau, as well as the new items and enemies, new locations and sounds, lockpicking mechanics and a new boss - the Great Dragon!
This is a big update that fixes many bugs and significantly changes the balance of the combat system. This will most likely be the last update before the full game is released.
Let me remind you that the full version of Hero's Story will have a complete storyline, tutorial and a final boss.

You can find the full list of changes below!


[h3]General[/h3]

[list]
[*] Game version was updated to 1.1 RC2
[*] Now when you hover over an item in your inventory, its price will be shown
[*] Now the price of all items will be at least 1 gold
[*] Now you can also attack enemies using RMB
[*] Players will now have some chance of dealing critical damage
[*] Changed the 'Warehouse' level music theme
[*] Updated control scheme for the keyboard
[*] Updated game credits scene
[*] 'Credits' section in main menu has become active again
[/list]
[h3]Additions[/h3]

[list]
[*] New region: Isil Plateau
[*] New boss: Great Dragon Krde
[*] New game mechanics: Lockpicking
[*] New game mechanics: Chaos Portals
[*] New location: Abandoned House
[*] New location: Throne Room
[*] New location: Troll's Cave
[*] New enemy type: Mountain Troll
[*] New enemy type: Griffin
[*] Added new NPCs
[*] Added new items and sounds
[*] Added new pop-up notifications
[*] Added new hidden Steam achievement
[*] Added the ability to return to the Duke's Keep
[*] Added portals to the Endless Desert (for faster travel)
[*] Added passage to the Sacred Grove from the Magic Forest and back
[*] An auto-run key has also been added to the controller (Back/left stick)
[*] Added new testing level
[*] Added more materials for the full version of the game
[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]

[list]
[*] Now all enemies will drop at least something upon their defeat
[*] Increased the amount of health restored by Healing Potion from 50 to 60
[*] Increased the amount of energy restored by Energy Potion from 50 to 60
[*] Reduced damage dealt by Mysterious Sphere to rakshasas
[*] The shooting mechanics of Skeleton Archers have been changed (it has become more accurate)
[*] Outlaws will now be able to apply bleed, but Zombies will not
[*] Increased Zombie health
[*] Now the Zombie will have a small chance of poisoning the player
[*] Changed the attack animation of the Sea Giants
[*] Increased damage of the Sea Giants
[*] Reduced the attack speed of the Sea Giants
[*] Skeleton Warriors and Rakshasa Warriors will now be able to block some of the melee attacks
[*] Increased damage of Rakshasa Warriors
[*] Reduced attack speed of Rakshasa Warriors
[*] Now Sorceresses and Rakshasas will be able to teleport during fight
[*] Sorceress and Rakshasa attack speed has been slightly reduced
[*] High Necromancer's health was significantly increased
[*] Spider Queen health was significantly increased
[/list]
[h3]Optimization[/h3]

[list]
[*] Removed unused game levels
[*] Removed some unused code fragments
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a critical bug when game settings were not saved correctly
[*] Fixed a graphical bug when particles from being hit by the Mysterious Orb would be replayed
[*] Fixed a bug when the sounds of eating and drinking were not always played
[*] Fixed a bug when it was impossible to change the game language from the pause menu
[*] Fixed a bug when location names did not appear after cutscenes
[*] Fixed a bug when the sounds of hitting the Spider Queen were too loud
[*] Fixed a bug when it was possible to get out of bounds in the Magic Forest
[*] Fixed incorrect placement of some landscape elements in the Expanse
[*] Minor fixes to buildings in the Expanse
[*] Minor changes to game levels
[*] Minor fixes
[/list]

Let's take a closer look at some points.

[h2]GREAT DRAGON[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/c3f12b002d5864b76152693f44c6460eb5569853.gif[/img]

It was always possible to get through the Isil Gorge into the Swamp of Myths via a single bridge, built during the Old Era.
Rumor has it that a huge dragon recently settled on this bridge! This winged monster has killed many knights and now terrorizes the lands of Central Teandria.
The king will generously reward anyone who can crush or drive away the powerful creature. In the battle with the dragon, potions of protection from fire and magic will help you.

[h2]NEW REGION[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/393168fee1dc37d94a93c9a686fef84481c1753f.gif[/img]

The mountain range north of Enthor divides the lands of Central Teandria into a few separate regions.
One of these areas is the Isil Plateau, which will be available to players in this update!
The new region consists of several zones and includes several new locations, including an abandoned hut on a hill and a troll cave on a cliff.
Only the most experienced adventurers will be able to defeat all the enemies in this area and collect all of the treasures.

[h2]LOCKPICKING[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/b14d363dfd1e1ef2bb4869a0c5699f7c5ed80b2d.png[/img]

During your adventures in the lands of Central Teandria, you probably came across locked chests.
Now you can try to open these chests using a new item - lockpick.
The more valuable the contents of the chest, the more difficult it is to unlock it! Lockpicks can be obtained from chests or found in different caches.

I also remind you that a small demo version of the game is available on Steam store page.

Enjoy the game, and see you in the full version! Your Silent.

They say that the old knight himself still wanders in dungeons of the family crypt in Expanse! Who can get into the dungeon and put ghost of the past to rest forever?

notes.title: Controller Support
notes.notes:
Greetings, Heroes! I just wanted to share information on how you can connect almost any controller to play [b]Hero's Story[/b].

[olist]
[*] Right-click on the name of the game in the list of Steam games and select “Properties”
[*] In “Properties” menu, select the “Controller” tab
[*] Make sure your controller is connected to PC and Steam (blue circle to the left of the controller type)
[*] Click on the Steam input system settings selection field
[*] Select “Enable Steam input” In the drop-down list
[*] Controller Steam input system status should change to “Enabled, per-game override”
[*] Close the “Properties” menu and start the game. Have fun!
[/olist]

This instruction includes PS Dualshock/DualSense and Xbox Controllers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/0c1a41dda05fd1df06bdfa16f269fe315df47687.png[/img]

Important Note: controller support is still under development and will be enhanced in the future updates!

notes.title: Hero's Story Dev Blog #8
notes.notes:
Greetings, Heroes!

On the eve of the release of a major update for Hero's Story, I would like to tell you about the creation of a new region - Magic Forest - as well as about the changes in the game world that await players in version 1.0.9.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/0126944dfe4279096374704ef556353217326dee.png[/img]

I want to say that I immediately decided to make the Magic Forest a little smaller in size than Expanse or the Endless Desert. This decision was dictated by the fact that most of the first two regions were almost empty, there was not as much content (especially in the first versions) as I would like, but optimization suffered at the same time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/cdaa9f09fe6a92e2b64a7b137a97d07717f351f5.png[/img]

The first thing to do when creating a new large location is to immediately determine what kind of landscape will be presented at the level. Will there be a river or mountains on the map? How many large points of interest will there be? Will there be access to the sea or chasm? At the first stage, mountains and hills are plotted on the map, rivers and lakes are formed, places for future castles and fortresses are imagined.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/4ebe529feb35ef3c4de0ec8b1ced4ee74b5dda79.png[/img]

The second stage is the arrangement of the main objects (for example, for Magic Forest these were huge trees of wisdom and bridges) and application of textures to the landscape. The bottom of rivers and the shore become sand, hills and mountains - stone, and lowlands and plains - grass. At the same stage the landscape is adjusted, ascents and descents are created, lighting is being figured out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/9edb327d8a608ab7d206ce4b1e50a6f2abae3f57.png[/img]

The next stage is the main objects and vegetation. I advise you to always place settlements, castles, fences and other objects before setting trees, but after landscape corrections, because the longer you edit the map, the more difficult (and longer) process of making various changes will be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/e84a558687ac80dc1a6bd5431f2fc22c47740f1d.png[/img]

The final touches are adding trees and adjusting the lighting. In the case of the Magic Forest the vegetation on the map has become many times more, so special attention was paid to customization of materials. For example, there will be no dynamic weather in the new region, and brushes are used instead of static meshes (models) where it's possible. Later enemies, chests, flowers and other objects are placed on the level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/b89d0a0bd47d058d0f7682e5f162fee3466d6327.png[/img]

That's it for today! And the new update, which also includes new types of enemies and removes "invisible walls" in the game world will be available on June 21th.

Have a good one, Your Silent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/22b0872c3d329fb2079e821b6997e09c33d02504.png[/img]

Later, the cruel duke remade the structure to suit his dark needs, but after Enthor relationship with Solheim went through another crisis, the guards again use it for its intended purpose. Players gain glory points as the game goes on by performing various actions (i.e. finding treasure). notes.title: Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Today exactly three years ago Hero's Story Early Access was released on Steam. During this time 37 updates were released, in which many game mechanics, levels, enemies and various items were added.
The game settings have been completely redesigned, inventory and a save system have been added, a lot of bugs have been fixed, weather effects have been added. New Steam achievements, bosses and destructible objects have been added.
I would like to thank all the players who have supported me all these years, left their feedback, share screenshots and just explored the vast world of Teandria!
Of course, I don't plan to stop there, and today I present to you anniversary update of Hero's Story Early Access.
In it I fixed some critical bugs, added fall damage and hints at the beginning of the game, and also introduced a new character class - Cleric!

Let's take a closer look at some points.

[h2]NEW CLASS[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/809b38fbda638f8e178fab195f6ba6777a73ddaa.png[/img]

Clerics of the Order of Light have long been famous for their wisdom and mercy. These formidable adepts of light do not have obvious advantages, but also do not have strong disadvantages, which makes them universal warriors. Clerics also use healing spells more effectively.

[h2]FALL DAMAGE[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/bfe09d8ae582c5d6f85c3c0c11b6917273a48ef2.gif[/img]

Fall damage is another mechanic from earlier versions of the game, as well as one of the main mechanics in any modern game. Depending on how fast your character was moving, he will receive different amount of damage. At the moment, you can't die from falling in the game.

[h2]PUMPKIN COLLECTOR RETURNS[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/59a299b30f3e3f6e9d7d57f720da0a591a906db6.png[/img]

The annual event returns on the eve of the Halloween holiday. This time there will be no Pumpkin Skeletons waiting for you around the corner, but there will be a few more Pumpkins in the game world. Let me remind you that collecting pumpkins is not only pleasant, but also useful - after all, 10 of them are needed to get the achievement of the same name. And what kind of soup is obtained from them!

notes.title: Hero's Story Dev Blog #7
notes.notes:
Greetings, Heroes.

A lot of water has flowed since the release of the latest "Developer Diaries", and today I would like to tell you a little about the updates that have been released during this time! Or rather, about how these updates were created.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/5c49e94c4c36650ed4680b25304816a93f5a6d83.png[/img]

One of the important areas of development was updating the first levels of the game - for this I had to completely redo them using new assets. As a result, the beginning of the game has become brighter, more spacious and understandable to players. At the same time, I learned how to better adjust lighting and optimize closed levels by using meshes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/3e80870436405deda2bbc8345d7ad5d60d4da9cd.png[/img]

Not without new locations and enemies. Many enemies in the Hero's Story game are humanoids of one kind or another, so it turned out to be very useful for them to "transfer" animations from one skeleton to another, when you can reuse the same set of movements! It saved me a lot of time while adding new NPCs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/998d7427376e9862583427318b76a946a4ac63b6.png[/img]

Speaking of new locations, a second open area has been added over the past time - an Endless Desert. I can't say that I have included everything I originally planned in it, but I plan to add more content as updates are released. What worries me a little is that I have not mastered level streaming, so I have to impose certain restrictions for optimization - for example, reduce the number of game objects on the level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/dacf9d13c590df8f4da3da67d47f8ddc818b9e4b.png[/img]

In the future, the game will have even more enemies, items, levels and bosses. Somewhere I will use (or already use) the work of previous years, somewhere I buy the necessary materials, and something I do myself, but in any case, I do it with my soul! In the new update, for example, the attackable goblins will appear in the game, which were originally planned to be like this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/e362ef6041188f4d970cb8b5424b1960b33aff25.png[/img]

I could have talked for a long time about the dialogue trees, about the fact that the first boss was supposed to be the Spider Queen, and not the Necromancer, about the fact that I never had time to finish the traps and ladders in current version, but the main thing, as I believe, is that Hero's Story is evolving and does not stand still, and all thanks to your continuous support!

And the next Early Access update is scheduled for release [b]on 21st of October[/b]!

Be strong, take care. Sincerely, Silentplaygames.

*in the updated form - Lesser Heal (H) restores less health, and a Fireball (F) requires more magical energy expenditure

**for example, a Lesser Heal restores more health (20% for 20 mana vs. 10% for 20 mana for other classes), and a Fireball spends less energy (50 vs. 100 for other classes)

[h2]Great Tomb[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/fceb74a96aeefc2531f8ab91caef8e864dd46fcc.png[/img]

The new location of Hero's Story is located in the very south of the Endless Desert, behind the Oasis. Like the Crypt, the Tomb is a combat location, and in it you will have to meet a lot of enemies. Ask the characters who are in the Endless Desert - perhaps they will be able to tell you more! The Tomb of the Damned serves as a haven for the dark Necromancer and his hordes of the undead. They say that during his lifetime Andros was a powerful sorcerer, so even the spirits of the deserts - Rakshasas - guard his peace.

[h2]New enemies[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/8dc4bf1ba2a0a8ccfad80a742a7e45396f0e4a15.png[/img]

The Tomb of the Damned is the only (so far) haven of Mummies and Skeletal Warriors. Mummies are extremely slow, but also extremely tenacious enemies, dangerous in large numbers. Skeletal Warriors are armed with iron swords and wooden shields, thanks to this, Skeletal Warriors are better protected, and cause more damage than ordinary Skeletons. Also, you will now more often encounter Skeletons-Mages - quite dangerous enemies, with whom it is better to immediately reduce the distance (or avoid meeting them at all).

[h2]First boss[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/6d2b33cc78ed604c1ea0bf59c124a2b2f0a48ca5.png[/img]

The necromancer Andros was a powerful wizard of Angalar during his lifetime. One day he went to explore the ancient teandrian ruins and did not return. Now he is dragging out a miserable existence as a walking corpse, but you can help him find a well-deserved rest! Together with Andros, his loyal warriors and adventurers who went with them are buried in the tomb. In battle, the Necromancer can summon skeletal servants. To win, you need to actively move around the arena, use the spells that have returned to the game and take care of the servants of Andros in a timely manner!

Have fun! Your Silent.

Chests of gold were introduced in the very first versions of the game, but after moving to a new engine, they were gone. Now, finally, the treasure chests are returning - with improved mechanics and visual. The contents of the chests are selected randomly, and the treasures inside have a certain drop chance. For example, you will more often come across empty chests or chests with one coin than chests with a handful of gold coins or keys. In some cases, the chests are well hidden, and you will have to work hard to get them!

[h2]Endless Desert[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/34dec66a21a7806d852d36cad4f40ec3c75ca041.png[/img]

The Endless Desert is the second of the planned zones in the Hero's Story game. It is a desert with ruins, cacti, oases and ancient secrets. To get into this zone, you need to get out of the Duke's Prison and move along the road towards the mine. New locations in this zone will be opened gradually with the release of updates, as was the case with Expanse. Endless Desert is approximately equal to the Expanse in scale, but all the objects were placed manually.

[h2]New Enemies[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/4ecef67c721862785e60bd8772533cb35783ef09.png[/img]

Rakshasas are restless desert spirits who pose a serious threat to our hero. They notice our hero much better than skeletons and have better combat characteristics. Rakshasa warriors, among other things, have an increased health reserve due to a thicker chitinous shell. I recommend fighting them with full stamina, luring them out one at a time! As a rule, Rakshasas guard ancient ruins or passages to them.

notes.title: Beta Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello, heroes!

Yesterday pretty big update for Hero's Story was released, which updated game levels, disabled temporary abilities and spells, as well as corrected sounds, lighting, interface, and much more. Let's look through each item in more detail!

[h3]General[/h3]

The game has been updated to the beta version. This means that the mechanics and solutions added to the game now are likely to remain in the release version. The game version itself remains the same (1.0.6), as many changes were not included in the first beta update.

[h3]Interface[/h3]

Main menu scene has been updated. Some of the labels used for debugging the game were removed too. I also plan to update Settings menu in the upcoming updates.

[h3]Character creation[/h3]

The choice of faction 'allegiance' was replaced with the choice of character's 'origins'. For now, this is more of a cosmetic change, but in the future, the faction selection will be updated to the character's starting class selection. Choosing a random faction was removed from the game, because it was not popular and did not make much sense in terms of lore.

[h3]Game levels[/h3]

The first levels of the game have been completely reworked. On the other levels, the lighting was changed.

[h3]Physics[/h3]

Some game objects had their physics disabled to make the game more stable. At this stage, there is no clear separation between which objects are dynamic and which are not, and this is what I plan to fix in future updates.

[h3]Sound and music[/h3]

Some sounds have been replaced or removed from the game. For example, many players were annoyed by the loud sound of the character's armor - it was made quieter. On the first level with the dungeon, the intense music was replaced with more atmospheric background sounds from the old version of the game. And so on.

[h3]Balance[/h3]

Fireball and Healing are no longer available for use from the start of the game. These abilities can be learned in future updates (at least Fireball).

[h3]Artificial Intelligence[/h3]

Despite the fact that some flaws in enemy animations have been corrected, artificial intelligence remains one of the main problems of the game at the moment, and will be developed further.

[h3]Optimization[/h3]

The primitive geometry on some of the levels was replaced with more optimized meshes. In the Expanse has been reduced draw distance of the vegetation for optimization.

[h3]System requirements[/h3]

System requirements have been updated. Hero's Story can be launched on weaker machines, but due to not quite optimal use of video memory and the recommended amount of RAM, it is recommended to install the game on 64-bit systems.

Have fun!

Your Silent.

notes.title: Beta is coming

Hello, heroes!

A year has passed since the release of Hero's Story in Steam Early Access, it's time to take some stock.
During this time, a lot of updates have been released - both fixing bugs and adding new content.
However, the game does not stand still, and it's time to start a new stage!
In the coming days, a major update will be released for Hero's Story, and the game will go into beta status.
For me, as a developer, this primarily means moving from temporary mechanics to more stable, permanent solutions. For players - a more complete and interesting game.
For example, many players have complained that first levels of the game are dark, boring, and unoptimized - the player's opinions are important to me, so I took the time to update first locations.
Also, all temporary spells and abilities will be removed (e.g. healing) - players will have to learn them later.
Now at the beginning of the game, the player will not have weapons anymore - you will have to search for them on your own to survive in the harsh world of Teandria!
Of course, the first beta update will not include all the planned changes, but no one is saying that it will be the last :)
I can't wait to see your feedback on the updated version of the game.

notes.title: Hero's Story Dev Blog #6
notes.notes:
Greetings, Heroes.
Today I will tell you about last major update, in development of which was updated Expanse - one of the Hero's Story outdoors locations, and a little bit - about the game's future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/e006d8676f6ced5aca70ed8f1c4da10151eb1740.jpg[/img]

I'll start with the fact that Expanse is probably the biggest location I've done in all of my games, and that I moved the game to the new engine precisely for the sake of efficient rendering of large open spaces. I started with a large square stub without textures or any objects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/fe168f4374c19a107f3c9fa3f9cc198aea6dfd4a.png[/img]

Of course, in process of creating any level you can use ready-made maps, or use a certain landscape generator (especially if you are an indie developer). However, I came to the conclusion that a more primitive, but hand made location is better than those made by someone else.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/f78e510a64973f3aa439db14e2ff2ff702503355.png[/img]

During the development there were several options for the color scheme and lighting of the level, but in the end I decided on warm colors that do not irritate players eyes. Also at the request of the players, the vignette effect was removed, and the blur was reduced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/0a0c5ce1102d7586f9c020389b493504fe025e32.png[/img]

During the creation of Expanse I encountered many difficulties - the area of the level was too large to properly bake the lighting, the shadows were too dark, and the performance left much to be desired...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/fffc27fa05401f8547cfb386834fb62e0aed956a.png[/img]

I have managed to partially smooth out these problems by changing objects settings, but the day and night cycle had to be temporarily disabled for improvement. In the future I plan to add weather effects as well. In total there will be five large open zones in basic version of the game (including Expanse).

And the next Early Access update is scheduled for release within 1-2 weeks!

Be strong, take care. Sincerely, Silentplaygames.

First of all, I want to thank everyone who supported the project and wrote a review in the comments in the relevant discussion topics! I remind you that all found errors can (and should) be reported to the appropriate [url=https: / / steamcommunity.com / app/649970/discussions/0/1607148447827991729/] topic [/url]. Your suggestions to improve the gameplay please write [url=https: / / steamcommunity. com / app/649970/discussions/0/1607148447827992918/] here [/url]. Also feel free to write to the support email address if your problem requires urgent attention - for example, buttons for AZERTY keyboards were included in the control scheme this way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/4af685400fa0262b0d2651ec9d63a8fba0e38cc7.png [/img]

Secondly, not all of the planned content managed to fit in the first two weeks after the release of the game in Early Access, and there are several technical reasons for that. 
For example, when creating the Cave location, I used old 3D models designed for Unity. When imported to Unreal, these models fell apart into hundreds of pieces, lost collision and scale. This is due in part to the fact that you can not directly import prefabs from Unity to Unreal, and, of course, it is very inconvenient. 
However, the problem with the collision was solved with just one tick, but with the pieces had to work - in the case of Mines, every tunnel, every lantern, every segment of the path was going (or rather-reassembled!) manually, which led to additional time costs. The problem with the scale (size) is present in all game engines, and there is no escape from it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/af45fdce0cfbdc2e0c9794fdbf64f3851f57b899.png [/img]

Also in the Cave for the first time there were problems with the light, which were partially solved by installing torches there, as well as adding a post process and changing its settings. In any engine, there are restrictions on the number of light sources, as well as features of their interaction (for example, in Unreal, point light sources simply turn off each other when superimposed). And so far, some levels in the game are too dark, and some are too light, so the light will still await adjustments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/49d9558ef24bf2f3199b1f035897216c593ef2a7.png [/img]

The third thing I would like to talk about is plans for the near future.
In terms of settings, it is planned to add ability to invert the mouse, because for some of you it was vital. In terms of locations - to update the Expanse (the first and so far the only open area available to players), to make it bigger.

notes.title: Hero's Story Dev Blog #2
notes.notes:
Greetings, Heroes! 
In anticipation of Hero's Story's Early Access, I'd like to share with you some fresh details about the game's development.
Since the last announcement, a lot has happened - the process of switching to a new engine has continued, a small prototype has been made and closed testing has begun. But everything in order.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/0cca6db0c4f17aee341990b5374293f4f1ec3cd1.png[/img]

In 2013, when I first started developing Hero's Story, I used the Unity engine. The main advantages of Unity at that time were free and relatively easy to learn. There were also disadvantages - for example, a few years ago, the documentation of the engine was less complete, and the errors were much more. I thought it would work - it didn't.
Over time, I began to think more and more about switching to another engine - one of the main reasons was the need to render large open spaces in real time. Unity is a good engine and C# is a great programming language, but my project needed something different.
Soon a new engine was chosen - it was Unreal Engine, which became free in 2015! An added bonus of UE is softer lighting and powerful built-in editing tools.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/134fb8ac53676c329b0313318970efff05785724.png[/img]

Starting to slowly master Unreal, I began to transfer the old demo to the new engine. Of course, most of the materials of the game at the same time became irrelevant - program code, levels, game objects, materials for the build and so on. Some of the materials were transferred without loss or quickly restored - for example, dialogues, quests, 3D models. 
Despite the fact that the "move" took some time, I believe that the transition to a different engine went to the benefit of the game - however, it is the players to decide, as always.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/07ec52a91b48dc969994825638696ed5909dfcaf.png[/img]

I recently announced the start of closed testing of the game, and it paid off! Several people who played in the Pre Alpha version of the Hero's Story found out that the original build could not start at all for some users, and some basic functions did not work at all. Many critical bugs have been fixed (e.g. a broken volume setting). In the next update of the test version will also be fixed character animations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/49dace45d5b795ffb902101e89ed917496069774.png[/img]

Of the new mechanics-character Stamina characteristics, which is spent on a variety of combat techniques and running. There is still a lot of work to do after the release of Early Access.
I remind you that the launch Of early Access Hero's Story is scheduled for October 21!

Be strong. Sincerely, Silentplaygames.

notes.title: Early Access Pros & Cons
notes.notes:
Greetings, Heroes!

There are a lot of articles written on the Internet about “Pros and Cons of Steam Early Access” both for the game itself and for the players. Today I would like to share with you my thoughts about the upcoming Early Access of Hero's Story and how this may affect the game.

Firstly, I am sure that in my case Early Access is rather good than bad. Some players are waiting for the game from 2013, and after a series of transfers, failures and frost, it is better to release the project at least in some state than not releasing at all - otherwise Hero's Story risks joining the “cool games that the world never saw”.

Secondly, Early Access will help get feedback from you, dear players, and make the game better. For example, now I think that there are more than enough dungeons, and they are well balanced, but in fact, maybe there are not enough treasures, or the enemies are too strong. There are questions about the design - is it convenient to control the game, does it run correctly on different machines, and which FPS it produces.

Thirdly, in my case (I remind you that I work alone) this is a good way to successfully continue and complete the project from a financial point of view - because I still do not plan campaigns on Kickstarter or similar sites for my projects. Having released the backbone of the game in Early Access, I plan to add new game zones, enemies, quests, and perhaps even game mechanics.

Finally, Early Access can be bad because the game will come out raw and scare away the audience. In the bottom line we have:

Pluses:
+ The price of the game in the Early Access will be less
+ Players will be able to play the game earlier
+ Ability to influence the development process
+ Free updates

Minuses:
- The game may be less stable
- The amount of content in the first versions can be much less

These are my thoughts. What do you think? Let me remind you that Hero's Story Early Access is scheduled for September of this year.

Stay strong! Your faithfully, Silentplaygames.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32275937/338970697d04a6b31e953d16ed3ab9e14bf554db.png[/img]

What i want to see in Early Access version of Hero's Story?
– Solid core gameplay
– At least few hours of exploring the game world
– Stable game build with Steam achievements, Cloud Saving and potential for replayability
Also before the end of the year there will be some trailers showing scope of the project!

In the end of this announcement i want to share with you one of the prototype screenshots and example of game's combat UI and magic abilities. This will be changed during further development for sure.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3iCnHS9sZ10WLlwu33/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/kgSFgCpY9HI3XL1CYe/giphy.gif[/img]

Stay strong! Best wishes, Silentplaygames.
